Issue: https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/issues/3712
Title: OpenRouter provider incompatible with GPT-5 models requiring max_completion_tokens

The request generated by claude-mem contains:

"max_tokens":4096

The upstream model only accepts:

"max_completion_tokens":4096

Error:

Unsupported parameter: 'max_tokens' is not supported with this model.
Use 'max_completion_tokens' instead.
